body_lead: BENGALURU: In a first of its kind initiative in India, the Karnataka Agriculture Department is preparing to introduce an Artificial Intelligence-powered platform to provide farmers with region-specific advisories and real-time information. The system, expected to be launched by Kharif 2026, aims to benefit more than one crore farmers across the State. Agriculture Department Director GT Putra said the platform is being developed in association with ISRO, Karnataka State Remote Sensing Applications Centre and BEL, and it will be ready in the next few months.
